addiction-studies-diploma.description:
The two-year Addiction Studies Diploma program provides learners with comprehensive knowledge and practical preparation for a career in the addiction field. Through a blend of theory and hands-on learning, students develop the skills to support individuals, families, groups, and communities affected by substance use and related challenges.
This program emphasizes ethical, trauma-informed, strengths-based, and culturally responsive practices, preparing graduates to assess, plan, and implement evidence-based interventions across diverse populations. Learners engage in critical self-reflection to explore personal beliefs and values, fostering the development of professional competencies essential for working with diverse clientele.
Graduates are equipped to meet the certification standards of the Canadian Addiction Counsellors Certification Federation (CACCF). Career opportunities include support roles in non-profit and private agencies, community-based organizations, schools, addiction services, residential settings, senior care facilities, and government organizations.

advanced-entertainment-arts-production-m.description: Advanced Entertainment Arts Production Management for VFX, Film, TV and Games is a full-time, two-year program focused on the fundamentals of production management as it pertains to pre-production, production and post-production processes. business-administration-human-resources-.description:
The field of Human Resources (HR) is growing and changing faster than ever. Today HR is emerging as an agent of change, driving decision-making in organizations. As workplace skills change all over the world, so does the scope of HR.

 The focus of the Human Resources Major is on aligning the workforce with the strategic direction of the organization. An introduction to the function of human resources and in-depth learning on talent acquisition and engagement, compensation and benefits, occupational health and safety, employment law, labour relations, and change management are covered in this major. Completion of the Human Resources Major will allow the graduate to apply for waiver to write the National Knowledge Exam, which is the first step to obtain the Chartered Professional in Human Resources (CPHR) Candidate designation, creating a clear pathway to full CPHR Designation.

open-studies.description:
Open Studies gives you the following opportunities:  
• Get credits in a Bow Valley College post-secondary program.  
• Explore programs at the College before you commit to one program.  
• Take post-secondary courses while you take upgrading or English Language Learning courses.  
• Enroll in courses that interest you without planning to apply to a certificate or diploma.  
• Enroll as a visiting student (you are a visiting student if you study at another post-secondary institution).  

Every term, we offer a selection of courses from our programs. Each of our schools determines which ones will be available. We don't offer work placement courses, including practicums and co-op courses, through Open Studies. There is demand for Pharmacy Technicians in the areas of hospital, community, and long-term care. The program has Full Accreditation Status with the Canadian Council for Accreditation of Pharmacy Programs (CCAPP), preparing graduates for the Pharmacy Examining Board of Canada's national certification exam and registration with the Alberta College of Pharmacy.

With a commitment to flexibility, the program offers evening and weekend instruction, workshops, and home study, while a dedicated practicum component provides the opportunity to apply acquired knowledge and skills, culminating successfully in the program.

registered-nurse-pathway-to-canadian-pra.description: The Registered Nurse Pathway to Canadian Practice is designed to support internationally educated nurses (IENs) and inactive or returning nurses in meeting requirements to practice in Canada. This comprehensive program provides the theoretical knowledge, skills and professional competencies necessary to ensure safe and effective nursing practice. This program empowers nurses with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to excel in their professional careers while ensuring high-quality patient care in Canada’s healthcare system.

risk-management-certificate-of-achieveme.description: Targeted towards industry professionals, this three (3) course certificate of achievement allows you to complete the educational requirements and challenge the national exam to obtain your Canadian Risk Management (CRM) designation offered by the Global Risk Management Institute.

social-work-diploma.description: The two-year Social Work Diploma program at Bow Valley College will provide learners with comprehensive knowledge and preparation for a career in social work practice. The Social Work program equips students with the skills to support individuals, families and communities while championing social justice and advocacy. In addition to learning the foundations of Social Work students will develop critical thinking skills, empower change through advocacy, and learn self-reflection. Social Work Diploma graduates work in non-profit and private agencies, including diverse community-based organizations, schools, addiction services, residential settings, senior care facilities, health care settings and government organizations.

software-development-apprenticeship-styl.description: The Software Development - Apprenticeship Style program prepares learners for related employment in the technology industry. Learners in the program will gain practical experience in the software development industry by working part time in a company on real-industry projects while completing an accredited college diploma. Learners gain exposure to industry standards in planning, developing, and quality assurance testing. A structured approach to problem-solving, effective communications, and attention to development standards and documentation will be stressed throughout the program. Graduates will be ready for careers in full-stack web development, application development, mobile application development, database administration, and agile project management.

software-development-post-diploma-certif.description: The Software Development Post-diploma Certificate prepares learners with prior post-secondary education for a career in software development, computer applications, database applications, data design, and systems analysis. Coding principles and systems analysis will be emphasized throughout the program. The intensive nature of this program will be challenging and learners are expected to be competent in computing technology. However, previous experience in software development or computer programming is not required. Graduates of this program will be ready for a career in computer programming, interactive game development, web application development, software testing, and quality control.
